context.purpose: Assess a bounded isotropic rectangular cantilever from beam/material/load intent with automatic quadratic meshes and native measured serviceability.
context.assumptions: SI m/N/Pa; x-axis beam, centred y/z section, complete fixed x=0 clamp, uniform consistent end shear in z. Small strain/deformation, slenderness 20..40 and no plasticity.
context.constraints: L 0.001..10 m, section 0.00001..1 m, aspect 0.5..2, E 1e6..1e12 Pa, nu 0..0.35, |F| 0.01..1e8 N, theory tip/L <= 0.01, engineering root stress/E <= 0.001. Base 12..24 axial and 2..3 section cells; separate 2x refinements. No generic FEA, imported decks, peak/root/yield stress certification.
context.inspection: Reconstruct every editable deck; parse complete native DAT with exact IDs and Gauss coordinates; independently check actual support force/moment balance, area-mean tip Uz and interior Sxx. Fresh exact-deck reopening and CSV/assessment/hash verification.
context.recovery: Invalid physical geometry fails before launch; numerical acceptance faults retain refinement/theory evidence; unmet named serviceability requirements retain measured margins and block consumers/reuse. Adjust stiffness/section/force or an explicit requirement and run a fresh attempt.
